name: MOUKABAL Adjustable Stainless Steel Over The Sink Dish Drying Rack (Matte Black)
description: Say goodbye to cluttered countertops! Selling an ultra-functional, space-saving MOUKABAL over-the-sink dish drying rack in premium matte black alloy steel. It features an ingenious expandable structure with a customizable length (25.9" to 33.4") and adjustable height (21.25" to 23") to perfectly clear your faucet and fit your sink setup. Comes complete with 4 designated draining baskets for plates, bowls, and utensils. Please note: This comes from a pet-friendly home with a lovely cat. The entire unit has been completely washed, sanitized, and wiped down, though a stray faint pet trace might remain. Skip the confusing assembly manual—this unit comes fully pre-assembled, structurally sound, and ready to immediately anchor over your sink!
contact_note: Fully pre-assembled for your convenience—no puzzle pieces to put together! Easily fits across any standard car backseat or trunk for local pickup. Please note that my home is cat-friendly; the rack has been deeply sanitized and deep-cleaned prior to listing.
meta_description: Buy a pre-assembled MOUKABAL adjustable over-the-sink stainless steel dish drying rack in matte black. Expandable length 25.9"-33.4". Cleaned and sanitized.
name_zh: MOUKABAL 可调节不锈钢水槽上方沥水架 (哑光黑)
